description: Packages in these groups define the active AUZiX runtime stratum. Leaf installs may depend on the current stratum but must not silently upgrade, shadow, or side-load a second glibc.
runtime_transaction_required_message: requested package requires a newer runtime substrate; rebuild the substrate layer first or select a compatible package version

single_core_glibc_rule.rebuild_rule: If any package requires a newer glibc symbol floor than the active AUZiX core glibc, update the core runtime as a release-layer and rebuild dependent packages against that new core. Do not pull a second glibc as a dependency.

runtime_linker_rule.trigger: after runtime/substrate extraction and after package post-install hooks
runtime_linker_rule.notes: Leaf package local libraries are exposed through wrappers/runtime ladders. The global loader cache belongs to the active AUZiX runtime substrate only.

groups.notes: C ABI, ELF loader, libm/pthread/resolver/NSS-adjacent runtime. Never force-install over a live root.
TLS ABI and CA trust must move as a coherent layer; Midori/Flatpak/browser fixes should not invent local CA drift.
Session, permissions, runtime dirs, devices, and service substrate.
Keyboard, mouse, video, and X11 ABI. Do not let app installs mutate this under a live E session.
E shell, efreet cache, EFL rendering, and terminal substrate. Version skew here looks like random desktop ghosts.
GTK/GNOME apps need this as a coherent cache/schema/icon/font loader stratum.

planner_rules.if: transaction_mode == leaf && dependency in substrate && dependency.version > active_substrate.version
